newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond market sets new record for Q1 issuance.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond market sets new record for Q1 issuance.

text.p: The volume of new issues in the international bond market in the first quarter has broken the previous record and may top $200 billion, according to preliminary figures from Capital DATA Bondware on Wednesday.
A Capital DATA report showed there have been 1,220 deals worth a total of $197.2 billion launched since January 1 at an average size of $162 million.
The same period in 1996, the prior record year, saw 1,135 deals worth $185.2 billion at an average $163 million.
The dollar remained the most popular currency, way ahead of all other currency sectors with a 40.8 percent market share ($80.5 billion) via 325 deals.

The mark was second with 14.9 percent ($29.4 billion). Sterling, boosted by a swathe of retail-targeted offerings as the pound soared on foreign exchanges, clocked up a 13.4 percent share ($26.4 billion).
They only include bonds to close of business on Tuesday.
